hook: Ever dreamed of hugging a panda?
narration: In Chengdu, your dream can come true. Visit the Giant Panda Reserve. See these gentle giants up close. Wander through bamboo forests. It's a wildlife adventure like no other. Are you ready to meet your panda pal?
